scope: Concrete execution plan only; no Docker pull/build/server/browser started
status: Prepared for root allocation after live Lab workload is terminal

docker.precondition: Record actual endpoint/ServerID/version/OSType after allocation; require expected Linux Desktop context, no WSL-native fallback

image_binding: Pull exact linux/amd64 manifest digest only after allocation; verify actual image identity and use pull=never for subsequent owned runs. Registry metadata is not proof of a successful local pull or runtime.

source.theme_check: Own fresh pinned tag checkout under Git mutex, verify exact HEAD; mount read-only at /theme for existing exe/modootoday-check
source.output_requirement: Fresh dedicated task root; preserve failed outputs, never repair historical incomplete artifacts
source.before_after: Capture fixed source snapshot and exact config/token/Gemfile.lock identities before and after; any drift refuses acceptance

builder.cache_reason: Official Jekyll --disable-disk-cache avoids writing .jekyll-cache under read-only source; no safe-mode/plugin/theme/token substitution
prerequisites: Probe existing compiler and OpenSSL development header; no apt/global install fallback
Install exact Bundler2.5.22 only into task GEM_HOME, then frozen bundle install --jobs1 and bundle-audit
Reject unsupported locked platform/dependency closure; do not modify Gemfile.lock
builder.second_build: Same exact upstream command, fresh /out/subpath and baseurl /humanymous
builder.requested_limit: one CPU,3GiB memory,256 PIDs; single bundle/native make job, one stage at a time
builder.actor: Unprivileged container UID/GID1000:1000, exact owned writable task paths

rust_validation.acceptance: Both authored/rendered denominators and errors, exact source-input commitment, archive/manifest/inventory hashes and restored bytes must agree. No cross-run bit-reproducibility claim or reuse of old hosted build for changed docs.
rust_validation.precondition: Recheck executable identity and use the already compiled owner tool; rebuilding needs a separate allocation
sequence: package --source ABS_SOURCE --site ABS_BUILT --archive ABS_VARIANT/artifact.tar --manifest ABS_VARIANT/manifest.json --restored ABS_FRESH_PACKAGE --baseurl VALUE
archive-check --source ABS_SOURCE --archive ABS_VARIANT/artifact.tar --manifest ABS_VARIANT/manifest.json --restored ABS_FRESH_SERVED --baseurl VALUE

serving.source: Only validated restored public output, never repository/private evidence/cache roots
serving.notes: Use corresponding container listen/publication port for each variant. No domain, directory browse, templates or access logging. Upstream file-server disables its admin API.
serving.requested_limit: Each server half CPU,256MiB,64PIDs; prefer one variant active at a time
serving.publication: Host literal127.0.0.1 only, verify chosen ports free; no public listener/DNS/Cloudflare/deployment
serving.subpath_root: parent containing only fresh consumer-restored humanymous/ directory
serving.phase: Only after both build/theme/Rust package and second-restore checks pass

lifecycle.readiness: Bounded literal-loopback HTTP probe, exact restored asset bytes, expected page/security target and source commitments before opening browser
lifecycle.supervision: Caller tracks actual Docker client session and container ID; on deadline/cancel stop exact owned ID with10second grace, wait/inspect terminal state and record cleanup. A client timeout or rm flag alone is not container cleanup proof.
lifecycle.builder_deadline: 20minutes per stage including native gem build; retain first failure and stop instead of loosening dependencies
lifecycle.server_deadline: 30minute initial preview lease; extensions require an explicit ongoing inspection, not an unobserved background server
lifecycle.forbidden_cleanup: No global prune, daemon shutdown, foreign container kill or deletion of computed/unverified paths
lifecycle.names: Unique task labels/names and captured exact container IDs/cidfiles
lifecycle.observation_owner: Keep an actual supervisor/session observing the bounded preview lease through handoff/cleanup. No unobserved indefinite server after a final reply; if a Rust lifecycle gap exists, obtain its own implementation/allocation rather than claiming a timeout flag is a supervisor.

checks: Real keyboard skip/focus/menu/search behavior and accessible names
Apex and subpath asset/link behavior, no horizontal overflow
browser.automated: Existing Rust browser command expects caller-owned local WebDriver/site endpoints and all rendered pages at two viewports; no chromedriver/msedgedriver was found on current PATH. Do not treat that PATH result as exhaustive machine inventory or start/install a driver without separate allocation.
browser.initial: Use requested built-in browser to inspect current actual restored candidate and leave user-visible preview when running under an observed bounded lease
browser.cua: Read current computer-use/browser API documentation before UI work; after observed CUA outcome emit required completion summary exactly once

allocation: Pending root release after serialized Lab work; metadata lookup and plan preparation only
